page.overview:
What is Chaos Shrine?

The Chaos Shrine, also known as the Temple of Fiends in the NES and Temple of Chaos in the PlayStation port, is a location in the original Final Fantasy. It is a ruin at the center of the archipelago in which Final Fantasy takes place. The shrine features a Black Crystal in Garland's chamber. Five bats are found in Garland's chamber as well. It is the first dungeon of the game, while its past incarnation serves as the final dungeon. The door to the center chamber will be locked until the player speaks with the King of Cornelia.

The floor in which the final boss is located is shaped like a hexagram (a triangle in the NES version) inside a circle, possibly representing the Seal of Solomon.

In several versions, entering the portal going to the Chaos Shrine of the past will normally not allow the party to return to the present. The only way they can return is to use the Teleport or Exit spell to leave the dungeon. This was changed starting from the Dawn of Souls port, where a portal going to the present Chaos Shrine was added behind the party when they appear in the past.

The Chaos Shrine is an ancient temple used as a hideout for the evil knight Garland. The Warriors of Light head to the Chaos Shrine to find him, as he holds Princess Sarah hostage. They defeat Garland, but fail to realize he was resurrected by the Four Fiends and transported into the past.
